name: s013_shroud_chain
description: Shroud bias scored at the Faraday cup: shroud 0 to +1 kV above the ioniser x target position -2, -1, 0 mm x cathode 8 and 10 kV, at 20 kV extraction, supply above the space-charge limit, with the beamline chain. Tests whether a separate shroud supply would raise the analysed current (locally: +40% at the CAD position, +50% at -2 mm, for +500 V).
